title: QueryParamDict.to_text leaves ';' unquoted, but from_text treats ';' as a pair separator
property: from_text(to_text(d)) gives back the same items as d, for any string keys/values and either full_quote setting
expected: ';' within a value is percent-encoded (%3B), so parsing the output returns [('a', 'b;c')]
actual: Output is 'a=b;c', which from_text parses as [('a', 'b'), ('c', None)]
evidence: to_text docs: full_quote=True percent-quotes special characters (fully-quoted URLs are 'necessary for sending over the network'). _QUERY_SAFE keeps sub-delims such as ';' unquoted, while parse_qsl in the same module splits on both '&' and ';', so the two halves of the module disagree and data is corrupted.
